title: Did you know… Elisha saw what others couldn’t—an unseen army?
paragraphs: Did you know… Elisha saw what others couldn’t—an unseen army?
At least—that’s what the servant saw.
But the prophet 2 Kings chapter 6 tells a different story.

Elisha’s servant woke up in panic.
Enemy armies. Horses. Chariots. Everywhere.
And then—Elisha speaks a sentence that sounds almost offensive in the face of danger:
“Do not be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”

That’s the tension.
That’s the mystery.
Because sometimes your situation looks louder than God’s promise.

Not for victory.
Not for escape.
But for vision.

Horses of fire.
Chariots of fire.
An unseen army—heaven’s defense, already in position.
The servant didn’t gain protection in that moment.
And that’s where grace walks in.

Because fear grows in what you can see.
But faith awakens when God shows you what you couldn’t.
If you belong to Jesus Christ, you are never surrounded by the enemy.
The enemy is surrounded by God.

The cross already settled the war.
Your sin? Paid.
Your shame? Nailed.
Your future? Secured in Him.
But like the servant, we still panic…
So today, don’t just ask God to change your situation.

See His presence.
See His power.
See the grace already surrounding you.
Someone you love is fighting a battle they can’t see through.
We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.
